title: Recover amide connectivity from NMR peaks
hypothesis: Return a molecular connectivity graph or ranked SMILES from two short peak lists.
why_hard: GPT-5.5 finishes all three records with status ok, finish_reason stop and 10644/9783/12206 completion tokens. Manual graph inspection finds a rank-one connectivity miss in repetitions 1 and 3, but the correct connectivity in repetition 2. No RDKit grading was run here. Screening: A concrete inverse problem and completed other-model answers, but prompts omit formula and mass. Source low accuracy cannot establish unique identifiability. No Terra evidence.
next_action: Review spectra and supporting publication; supply genuinely available formula/2D evidence if needed, then remeasure that changed task separately.
notes: Independent verifier: Canonical graph comparison plus independent chemical review that the supplied evidence distinguishes alternatives. Easy baseline: Fragment assembly from the amide carbonyl, aromatic pattern, tert-butyl and cyclopentyl signals. New source-screening card, outside the frozen original 100. No local model trial; not submission-ready.
